name: RecQ like helicase 4

function.text: RECQL4 encodes ATP-dependent DNA helicase Q4. Annotated molecular activities include helicase activity and ATP hydrolysis activity. It participates in DNA repair and telomere maintenance.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Rothmund-Thomson syndrome (autosomal recessive); Baller-Gerold syndrome (autosomal recessive). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
